sloka: ददृशुः तत्र हरयो गृह मुख्यानि सर्वशः ।पुष्पितान् फलिनो वृक्षान् प्रवाल मणि संनिभान् ॥४-५०-३२॥
transliteration: dadṛśuḥ tatra harayo gṛha mukhyāni sarvaśaḥ ।puṣpitān phalino vṛkṣān pravāla maṇi saṁnibhān ॥4-50-32॥

translations.english: They saw trees bright like corals in full bloom and ripe fruits. Golden bees were found hovering around making all kinds of honey.
